notes.subject: עשותה המזמתה הרבים
notes.rationale: 'she has wrought lewdness with many' vs 'doing much scheming' — verb form and plural subject disputed

notes.subject: ובשר קדש יעברו מעליך
notes.rationale: 'holy flesh passes from/over you' — sacrificial meat averting doom vs departing from you; grammar of עבר debated

notes.subject: לידידי
notes.rationale: 'my beloved' rendered descriptively; the affectionate term addressed to Israel is ironic here

notes.subject: verse
notes.rationale: deliberately opaque compressed oracle, widely regarded as textually difficult
